name: dsh-my-simple-desktop
description: A simple desktop wrapper for DeepSeek Harness (dsh web) — built with Electron
author: dsh-my-simple-desktop contributors

scripts.predist: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('dsh/node.exe')){console.error('ERROR: dsh/ directory missing. Run npm run build:runtime first.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.predist:plugins: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('dsh/node.exe')){console.error('ERROR: dsh/ missing. Run npm run build:runtime first.');process.exit(1)}if(!fs.existsSync('plugins-layer/manifest.json')){console.error('ERROR: plugins-layer/ missing. Run npm run build:plugin-layer first.');process.exit(1)}"
